question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Gear up for
solution:
The correct answer is 'Get ready for'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Gear up for is an idiom that means to prepare or equip oneself for something; get ready.

 
 
• ***Example*** - *Now the country needs to **gear up for **backing the domestic economy.*
 
 
 
• So, get ready for is the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom. 
 
• Hence, option 3 is the correct answer.
